proposed_fixes.title: Collapse closed policy InfoBars without changing global card spacing
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Source-supported hypothesis: IsOpen=false leaves layout residue associated with the InfoBar/template margin, whereas a collapsed control removes that contribution.
plan: Bind the warning's collapsed/visible layout state to the same ShowWarning state that controls IsOpen, using existing converter/template conventions.
Keep visible-warning margin, informational severity and accessibility semantics; do not alter SettingsCardSpacing globally.
Add a focused layout regression for wrapped cards with warning false/true and navigation refresh.
verification: Closed-warning card gaps match ordinary card gaps at 100% and 200% scaling.
Managed-policy warnings remain visible and accessible when opened; theme and navigation transitions do not leave stale gaps.
